5615.title: Thread-scoped Markdown reader state is discarded
5615.rootCauseOneLine: Instance-local reader offsets are pruned by another thread’s tabs, lost on remount, or shared across equal tab IDs.
5615.proposedFix: Keep in-session offsets per panel-state ID; preserve unscoped instance behavior and per-scope closed-tab pruning.
5615.caveats: Repeated by the same agent in two clean checkouts; Linux Chromium browser verified; macOS and native mobile not tested.
